title: Series 9000 cleaning reminder lit
shortDescription: Heads need rinsing or station cycle.
fullDescription:
Series 9000 lights the cleaning icon (water-drop) after each shave to remind you to rinse heads, or after the station cycle. The reminder clears once cleaned.

Clean by holding the heads under hot tap with motor running.

fixSteps.title: Rinse with motor on
fixSteps.instruction: Run head under hot tap, motor on, 30s.

title: SH98 head replacement reminder
fullDescription:
Philips logs runtime hours; replacement icon (with double arrow) lights at ~2 years usage. Replace heads with Philips SH98 (Series 9000), SH71 (S7000) or SH50 (S5000) sets.

Reset timer by holding power 7 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Buy correct heads
fixSteps.instruction: Match by model: SH98 / SH71 / SH50 etc.

fixSteps.title: Replace heads
fixSteps.instruction: Open frame, lift each disc out, insert new.

faq.q: Can I clean instead of replace?
faq.a: Past 2 years cutters dull regardless of cleaning.

title: Norelco won't charge
shortDescription: No green LED on charger plug.
fullDescription:
Series 9000 charges via barrel jack 15V or USB-C on newer S9000 Prestige. If LED never illuminates check adapter polarity, then internal Li-ion may have entered protect mode after deep discharge — leave on charger 24 hours.

Do not use generic 12V — ICs require 15V.

fixSteps.title: 24-hour soak charge
fixSteps.instruction: Leave plugged 24h to wake protect IC.

fixSteps.title: Open and inspect jack
fixSteps.instruction: Open shell — reflow charge jack solder if cracked.

whenToCallPro: If charging IC failed (no current draw).

faq.a: Only Series 9000 Prestige 2023+; older models use HQ8505 barrel.

title: Yellow battery LED flashing
fullDescription:
Yellow flashing battery icon = under 5 minutes runtime. Series 9000 supports 1-shave quick charge: 5 minutes on charger gives one shave.

If flashing yellow on full charge, cell pack is fading.

fixSteps.title: Full cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Run to cutoff, then full 1-hour charge.

fixSteps.title: Replace cell
fixSteps.instruction: If runtime <15 min on full charge, swap 18650.

faq.a: No — Philips will swap shaver under warranty only.

title: Travel lock active
fullDescription:
Hold power button 3 seconds — padlock icon shows and shaver is locked. Hold again 3 seconds to unlock; padlock blinks then disappears.

Not a fault.

faq.a: Prevents motor running in luggage and draining battery.

title: Series 9000 motor sluggish
shortDescription: Rotary heads not spinning at full RPM.
fullDescription:
Series 9000 PowerAdapt sensor scales motor speed to beard density. If heads are clogged, the load detector errs and reduces power.

Deep clean and lubricate cutter discs.

fixSteps.title: Disassemble heads
fixSteps.instruction: Open frame; remove each cutter and ring.

fixSteps.title: Brush and rinse
fixSteps.instruction: Brush each disc, rinse under hot water.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate
fixSteps.instruction: Drop of Philips HQ110 oil on each cutter.

whenToCallPro: If still slow after lube — motor faulty.

faq.a: Yes, food-grade light oil works in a pinch.

title: Wet/dry icon stuck on
shortDescription: Reminder shaver should be cleaned with water.
fullDescription:
Some Series 9000 show a solid water icon when motor activates after a shave — purely a hint to rinse heads. Holding power 5s clears the cycle counter.

Not indicative of fault.

title: SmartClean Pro low fluid
fullDescription:
SmartClean Pro stations use Philips JC305 cartridges with a chip; flashing droplet icon = empty. The cartridge expires after 3 months even if unused, due to evaporation.

Replace with genuine JC305.

faq.a: Aftermarket caps exist; chip resets are required.

title: Display dark but motor runs
fullDescription:
On Series 9000 Prestige a fall can detach the FFC ribbon between display and main PCB. Motor still runs from main PCB but display is dark.

Disassembly required to reseat.

fixSteps.title: Reseat FFC
fixSteps.instruction: Lift latch, reinsert ribbon, lower latch.

whenToCallPro: If panel cracked — replacement panel only via service.

title: Series 9000 all icons flashing
fullDescription:
Power-on self-test failure flashes all LEDs simultaneously. Brown-out, water in handle, or controller fault are likely.

Dry overnight, then hold power 10s with adapter unplugged for hard reset.

fixSteps.title: Dry overnight
fixSteps.instruction: Stand upright with cassette open in dry room.

title: Pop-up trimmer stuck
fullDescription: Pop-up trimmer mechanism stuck. Common diagnostic on Philips Shaver electric shaver. Resolve by following manufacturer service procedure.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean charging contacts or ports with soft cloth.

whenToCallPro: If reset/charge doesn't fix, contact warranty service.

faq.a: Most personal care devices have 1-2 year warranty.
Cleaning and reset usually fix common issues.
